┌─ Help: Quest chains and fighting ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Quest chains                                                                 │
│   Ctrl+K            the quest chain screen (or /quest); X there gives it up  │
│                     for good, after one question                             │
│                                                                              │
│   A new character is offered First Steps in Thornwick: talk to the Watch     │
│   greeter in Hawthorn Square, talk to your class trainer, take a contract    │
│   from the board, then go out through the east gate. It pays a small reward  │
│   at the end.                                                                │
│   It is optional. Nothing walks you anywhere and nothing reminds you; the    │
│   Quest chain panel shows the step you are on, and the log tells you when    │
│   one is done. A dismissed chain is never offered again.                     │
│   Other chains ask for more than a talk: bring items to someone ("Held: 2 of │
│   3" counts what your bags hold now), collect them, defeat a number of       │
│   creatures ("Kills: 2 of 5"), or watch a place for a time ("Watching… 12 of │
│   20 s"). A watch starts over when you leave the spot or a fight starts; the │
│   screen says so. The server tells the kills and the watch seconds when the  │
│   step changes, not as they rise.                                            │
│   A step can be in another zone: the quest screen names the zone and the     │
│   door to take, and how far away it is. A person who holds a chain you       │
│ Page 4 of 10  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
